scope: MySQL DELIMITER // token in comments and strings
contract: An active // delimiter inside a block comment, line comment or string literal does not terminate the routine.
The planner keeps the procedure through END// as the first statement and the query after DELIMITER ; as the second.
Formatting preserves the two-statement plan and named-parameter extraction excludes the placeholder in the routine body.
remaining: Other MySQL delimiter token forms and cross-dialect executable-identity cases remain open; this does not close B3 or qualify 0.2.0.
